subject.title: feat: add interactive launcher menu as thin wrapper over existing CLI

question: Should OpenClaw core own a new Rust interactive launcher menu, or should launch ergonomics stay in the existing CLI, onboarding, web, and native app surfaces for now?
rationale: The PR adds a new user-facing startup/setup and Rust build surface, so maintainers need to sponsor that product surface before automation can safely repair the remaining code defects.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow launcher redesign
options.body: Keep the idea alive only if the branch is narrowed to launcher files, delegates configured readiness/version behavior, wires build/package support, forwards exact CLI args, and proves real flows.

options.title: Decline core launcher for now
options.body: Close or pause this PR and direct launcher ergonomics toward existing onboarding/native app design work until maintainers explicitly sponsor the surface.

options.title: Accept core launcher ownership
options.body: Own the Rust launcher, packaging, upgrade, and support surface deliberately despite the added toolchain and compatibility responsibilities.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow launcher redesign
recommendation.body: Keep the idea alive only if the branch is narrowed to launcher files, delegates configured readiness/version behavior, wires build/package support, forwards exact CLI args, and proves real flows.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has feature-history ownership on the Gateway/TUI surfaces and is the strongest available routing owner for whether core should own this new launcher product surface.
